name: Workspace Layout
author: Bjarne Oeverli
description: Decide how a Hyprland workspace splits its screen. Drag the dividers and the real windows move under your cursor — 25/50/25, a 60/40 master, thirds, a grid, or anything you drag to. Layouts are named and reusable, workspaces pick the layout they want, and profiles switch every workspace at once for work, writing, or review.

barWidget.description: Live tiling ratios per workspace, with saveable layout profiles.
